name: Pixelcut
summary: AI photo and video editor for background removal, upscaling, object erasing and image or video generation.
description: An AI-first image editing suite for creators, e-commerce sellers and marketers: background remover, image upscaler, magic eraser, AI image and video generators, product photos, UGC ads and batch editing. Available as a web app with iOS and Android apps, plus documented APIs (remove background, upscale, generate background, outpaint, get credits) and an MCP server for agents.

web app plus iOS and Android apps
developer API and MCP server for integrating the tools
free plan; Pro and Business plans from $8 to $30 per month
